item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.21)] Jobs aren’t being lost so much as they’re changing: Top HR company CEO Prising
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.21)
Jonas Prising, CEO of ManpowerGroup, believes that while technology, particularly AI, is transforming the workplace, it is not primarily eliminating jobs. Instead, he attributes current hiring slowdowns to economic cycles and emphasizes that jobs are changing, requiring workers to adapt their skills and expectations. Prising highlights the shift towards human-machine collaboration, the need for new skills in advanced sectors, and the increasing importance of soft skills and real-life experience over traditional paper qualifications.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (-0.11)] Apple to change app data consent rules, German regulator says
item.description:

The FCO's investigation, which lasted several years, concluded that Apple's practices potentially breached competition rules. As a result, Apple has agreed to make changes to the text and formatting of the ATT prompt to ensure neutrality for third-party apps, with these commitments monitored for seven years and applicable in most EU countries.

item.description:
